findings.passage: PLEASE NOTE all citizens on probation or parole can now vote. You just have to re-register, which you can do WHEN YOU VOTE. Bring a Maryland state ID or driver’s license, and if possible proof of residency to your polling place.
findings.note: From her 2022 governor campaign site (page footer says 2023). Voter guidance telling people with past convictions to re-register at the polls and bring a state ID or driver's license, plus proof of residency if possible. It is instruction on registration, not a stated view on ID rules.
